  Devices (device_id PK, device_name, location, device_type)
  SensorData (data_id PK, device_id FK, timestamp DATETIME, temperature DECIMAL, humidity DECIMAL)

Queries:
1. List all sensor data from 'Living Room Thermostat' in the last hour.
2. Find devices with temperature readings above 25 degrees Celsius.
3. Calculate the average temperature for each device over the last day.
4. Add a new IoT device.
5. Insert new sensor data for a device.

title: Hotel Amenity Tracking
spec:
Schema:
  Rooms (room_id PK, room_number INT, room_type)
  Amenities (amenity_id PK, amenity_name, description)
  RoomAmenities (room_id FK, amenity_id FK)

Queries:
1. Show all amenities in 'Room 101'.
2. Find rooms that have a 'King Bed' and 'Ocean View'.
3. Count the number of rooms with each amenity.
4. Add a new amenity to a room.
5. Remove an amenity from a room.

title: Restaurant Order Details
spec:
Schema:
  Orders (order_id PK, order_date DATETIME, customer_name, total_amount DECIMAL, status ENUM('Pending', 'Completed', 'Canceled'))
  Dishes (dish_id PK, dish_name, description, price DECIMAL, category)
  OrderDishes (order_dish_id PK, order_id FK, dish_id FK, quantity INT, unit_price DECIMAL)

Queries:
1. List all 'Completed' orders from today.
2. Find orders that include 'Pizza'.
3. Calculate the total quantity sold for each dish.
4. Create a new order.
5. Add a dish to an existing order.

title: Employee Access Control
spec:
Schema:
  Employees (employee_id PK, first_name, last_name, department)
  Resources (resource_id PK, resource_name, resource_type)
  AccessPermissions (permission_id PK, employee_id FK, resource_id FK, access_level ENUM('Read', 'Write', 'Admin'), granted_date DATE)

Queries:
1. List all resources 'John Doe' has 'Write' access to.
2. Find employees with 'Admin' access to any resource.
3. Count the number of employees with access to each resource.
4. Grant a new access permission to an employee.
5. Revoke an employee's access to a specific resource.

title: Customer Support Call Logs
spec:
Schema:
  Customers (customer_id PK, first_name, last_name, email)
  Agents (agent_id PK, first_name, last_name, department)
  Calls (call_id PK, customer_id FK, agent_id FK, call_start_time DATETIME, call_end_time DATETIME, resolution TEXT, status ENUM('Open', 'Resolved', 'Escalated'))

Queries:
1. Show all 'Open' calls for 'Customer A'.
2. Find agents who handled more than 10 calls today.
3. Calculate the average call duration for each agent.
4. Log a new customer support call.
5. Update the status of a call to 'Resolved'.

title: University Exam Results
spec:
Schema:
  Students (student_id PK, first_name, last_name, major)
  Exams (exam_id PK, exam_name, course_id FK, exam_date DATE)
  Results (result_id PK, student_id FK, exam_id FK, score INT)

Queries:
1. List all results for 'Student A' in 'Calculus I' exam.
2. Find students who scored above 90 in any exam.
3. Calculate the average score for each exam.
4. Record a new exam result for a student.
5. Find the highest score for a specific exam.

title: Customer Feedback Survey
spec:
Schema:
  Customers (customer_id PK, first_name, last_name, email)
  Surveys (survey_id PK, survey_title, creation_date DATE)
  Feedback (feedback_id PK, customer_id FK, survey_id FK, submission_date DATETIME, rating INT, comment TEXT)

Queries:
1. Show all feedback for 'Product Satisfaction Survey'.
2. Find customers who gave a rating of 1 or 2.
3. Calculate the average rating for each survey.
4. Submit new feedback from a customer.
5. Update a customer's comment on existing feedback.
